diagnosis: VAD emitted a cut while DualTrackEngine.in_speech was still false. on_vad_candidate → WAIT set holding_cut; next chunk called _begin_utt() which wiped arbiter + holding_cut → segment vanished with no finalize_stream.
fix: Begin utterance (seed buf from seg.audio) BEFORE arbiter hold; _begin_utt(preserve_hold=True) when already holding; ENDPOINT_HOLD_TIMEOUT_SEC=3.0 force cut; empty ASR returns DualTrackStats instead of None.
